causes.label: The circuit breaker in the fuse box has tripped.
remedies: Check the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 12: "The circuit breaker in the fuse box has tripped."

causes.label: There has been a power cut.
remedies: Check whether the lighting in your room or other appliances are working.
Open the appliance. Following a power cut, the touch fields light up in ascending order from left to right. The display goes out after approx. 30 seconds and the appliance is ready for operation.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 12: "There has been a power cut."

symptoms.symptom: The appliance is switched on. The operation indicator does not light up.

causes.label: The operation indicator is defective.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 12: "The operation indicator is defective."

causes.label: The appliance heats up.
remedies: Wait until the appliance has finished heating up.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 12: "The appliance heats up."

symptoms.symptom: The cookware or food does not get warm enough.

causes.label: There has been a power cut.
remedies: Check whether the lighting in your room or other appliances are working.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 12: "There has been a power cut."

causes.label: The cookware or food has not been heated for long enough.
remedies: Heat the cookware or the food for a longer period of time.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 12: "The cookware or food has not been heated for long enough."

causes.label: The appliance is not completely closed.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 12: "The appliance is not completely closed."

symptoms.symptom: The appliance switches off. All displays are off.

causes.label: The safety shut-off has switched the appliance off.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 12: "The safety shut-off has switched the appliance off."

symptoms.symptom: The indicators light up. The appliance is not heating up.

causes.label: Demo mode is activated.

symptoms.symptom: The front panel is not aligned.
